name: Headache Relief Gel Cap Hot Cold Therapy | Migraine, Tension & Puffy Eyes Relief
description:
The Headache Relief Cap is designed with 360° gel coverage to ease migraines, tension, sinus pain, and puffy eyes. Its stretchable, seamless fabric ensures a snug, comfortable fit without pressure points. Ideal for both hot and cold therapy, this reusable cap helps reduce pain, inflammation, stress, and fatigue—making it a must-have for home, travel, or relaxation.
Key Features
 360° full coverage for head, eyes, and temples
 Hot & cold therapy for versatile relief
 Thick reusable gel retains temperature longer
 Stretchable, seamless, one-size-fits-most design
 Can be worn over or above eyes
 Lightweight and portable for travel or home use
Ingredients / Materials
Stretchable latex-free fabric, hydrogel insert
How to Use
 For cold therapy: Freeze for at least 2 hours, wear up to 15 minutes
 For hot therapy: Microwave in 30-second intervals (max 60 sec) or soak in warm water
 Slip on for migraine, sinus, or stress relief as needed
Package Includes
 1 × Headache Relief Gel Cap
